decision.reason: The nRF52840 module is a low-power Cortex-M4F SoC with native BLE and USB, which suits a battery-powered Bluetooth gamepad that needs long battery life and enough GPIO/ADC for two thumbsticks and buttons. The ESP32-S3 also works but draws m

Single cell Li-Ion/Po battery protection IC

decision.reason: A Bluetooth game controller with two thumbsticks is a compact, battery-powered device, and a single-cell 18650 holder (Keystone 1042) is an actual battery part that fits it. A rechargeable Li-ion cell suits the controller's power needs. The

card.summary: USB-Friendly Li-Ion Battery Charger and Power-Path Management, VQFN-16
Single cell, Li-Ion/Li-Po charge management controller, 4.20V, Tri-State Status Output, in SOT23-5 package
1A Standalone Linear Li-ion/LiPo single-cell battery charger, 4.2V ±1% charge voltage, VCC = 4.0..8.0V, SOIC-8 (SOP-8)
